titre: Exercices — Les quantifieurs (some, any, much, many)
consigne: Cherche chaque exercice au brouillon avant d'ouvrir le corrigé.

exercices.enonce: Complète (affirmatif) : There are ___ apples on the table.
exercices.reponse: There are some apples on the table.

exercices.enonce: Complète (négatif) : I don't have ___ brothers.
exercices.reponse: I don't have any brothers.

exercices.enonce: Complète (question) : Is there ___ juice left?
exercices.reponse: Is there any juice left?

exercices.enonce: Complète : How ___ students are in the class?
exercices.reponse: How many students are in the class?

exercices.enonce: Complète : How ___ sugar do you want?
exercices.reponse: How much sugar do you want?

exercices.enonce: Traduis (affirmatif) : « Elle a beaucoup d'argent. »
exercices.reponse: She has a lot of money.

exercices.enonce: Corrige : I have many informations.
corrige: « information » est indénombrable : pas de -s, et pas de many.
À l'affirmatif, on préfère « a lot of ».
exercices.reponse: I have a lot of information.

exercices.enonce: Corrige : Do you have some questions?
exercices.reponse: Do you have any questions?

exercices.enonce: Complète : There isn't ___ milk left.
exercices.reponse: There isn't any milk left.

exercices.enonce: Traduis : « Combien de livres as-tu ? »
exercices.reponse: How many books do you have?

exercices.enonce: Dénombrable ou indénombrable ? book, water, friend, rice
corrige: On peut compter des livres et des amis (books, friends).
On ne compte pas l'eau ni le riz : ils restent au singulier.
exercices.reponse: Dénombrables : book, friend. Indénombrables : water, rice.

exercices.enonce: Dénombrable ou indénombrable ? money, car, music, apple
corrige: car et apple se mettent au pluriel (cars, apples).
money et music ne se comptent pas.
exercices.reponse: Dénombrables : car, apple. Indénombrables : money, music.

exercices.enonce: Complète (affirmatif) : I bought ___ bread at the bakery.
corrige: Phrase affirmative → some (fonctionne avec un indénombrable comme bread).
exercices.reponse: I bought some bread at the bakery.

exercices.enonce: Complète (négatif) : We haven't got ___ homework tonight.
exercices.reponse: We haven't got any homework tonight.

exercices.enonce: Complète (affirmatif) : My mum has ___ friends in Spain.
exercices.reponse: My mum has some friends in Spain.

exercices.enonce: Complète (question) : Are there ___ shops near your house?
exercices.reponse: Are there any shops near your house?

exercices.enonce: Complète (offre polie) : Would you like ___ cake?
corrige: Une offre polie se fait avec some, même si c'est une question.
exercices.reponse: Would you like some cake?

exercices.enonce: Complète (demande polie) : Can I have ___ water, please?
exercices.reponse: Can I have some water, please?

exercices.enonce: Complète : There aren't ___ chairs in the room.
exercices.reponse: There aren't any chairs in the room.

exercices.enonce: Complète avec « much » ou « many » : How ___ brothers and sisters have you got?
exercices.reponse: How many brothers and sisters have you got?

exercices.enonce: Complète avec « much » ou « many » : How ___ money do you need?
exercices.reponse: How much money do you need?

exercices.enonce: Complète avec « much » ou « many » : I don't have ___ pens in my pencil case.
exercices.reponse: I don't have many pens in my pencil case.

exercices.enonce: Complète avec « much » ou « many » : She doesn't drink ___ coffee.
exercices.reponse: She doesn't drink much coffee.

exercices.enonce: Complète (affirmatif) : There are ___ tourists in London in summer.
corrige: Phrase affirmative : on préfère a lot of plutôt que many.
exercices.reponse: There are a lot of tourists in London in summer.

exercices.enonce: Complète (affirmatif) : He eats ___ fruit.
corrige: Phrase affirmative → a lot of (avec un indénombrable ou un dénombrable).
exercices.reponse: He eats a lot of fruit.

exercices.enonce: Complète : We haven't got ___ time, hurry up!
corrige: time (le temps qui passe) est indénombrable ; phrase négative → much.
exercices.reponse: We haven't got much time, hurry up!

exercices.enonce: Complète : Were there ___ people at the concert?
corrige: people est un nom pluriel dénombrable → many.
exercices.reponse: Were there many people at the concert?

exercices.enonce: Choisis entre some et any : I'm hungry. Is there ___ food in the fridge?
exercices.reponse: Is there any food in the fridge?

exercices.enonce: Choisis entre some et any : Sorry, there isn't ___ cheese, but there is ___ ham.
corrige: 1re partie négative → any ; 2de partie affirmative → some.
exercices.reponse: Sorry, there isn't any cheese, but there is some ham.

exercices.enonce: Choisis entre much, many et a lot of : I have ___ cousins: twenty!
exercices.reponse: I have a lot of cousins: twenty!

exercices.enonce: Choisis entre much et many : How ___ milk is there in the bottle?
exercices.reponse: How much milk is there in the bottle?

exercices.enonce: Corrige : How much apples do you want?
exercices.reponse: How many apples do you want?

exercices.enonce: Corrige : I don't have some money.
exercices.reponse: I don't have any money.

exercices.enonce: Corrige : There is many water in the bath.
corrige: water est indénombrable ; à l'affirmatif, on préfère a lot of.
exercices.reponse: There is a lot of water in the bath.

exercices.enonce: Corrige : I need some informations about the trip.
corrige: information est indénombrable : il ne prend jamais de -s.
exercices.reponse: I need some information about the trip.

exercices.enonce: Corrige : She hasn't got much friends.
exercices.reponse: She hasn't got many friends.

exercices.enonce: Traduis : « Il n'y a pas de lait. »
corrige: « Il n'y a pas » → There isn't.
exercices.reponse: There isn't any milk.

exercices.enonce: Traduis : « Combien d'eau bois-tu ? »
corrige: Question au présent simple : do you drink.
exercices.reponse: How much water do you drink?

exercices.enonce: Traduis : « Veux-tu des biscuits ? » (offre polie, biscuits = biscuits)
corrige: Offre polie → Would you like some ... ?
exercices.reponse: Would you like some biscuits?

exercices.enonce: Traduis : « Je n'ai pas beaucoup de devoirs. »
exercices.reponse: I don't have much homework. (ou : I haven't got much homework.)

exercices.enonce: Traduis : « Mon frère a beaucoup de jeux vidéo. »
exercices.reponse: My brother has a lot of video games.

exercices.enonce: Mets à la forme négative : There are some eggs in the box.
exercices.reponse: There aren't any eggs in the box.

exercices.enonce: Mets à la forme interrogative : There is some orange juice.
corrige: Question → some devient any ; on inverse There is → Is there.
exercices.reponse: Is there any orange juice?

exercices.enonce: Mets à la forme négative en remplaçant « a lot of » : He has a lot of free time.
exercices.reponse: He doesn't have much free time.

exercices.enonce: Complète la liste de courses : « We need ___ eggs and ___ flour, but we don't need ___ sugar. »
corrige: Phrases affirmatives → some ; phrase négative → any.
exercices.reponse: some – some – any

exercices.enonce: Complète le dialogue : « How ___ bananas do we have? — Not ___. Only two. »
exercices.reponse: many – many

exercices.enonce: Complète : « How ___ does this T-shirt cost? — Ten pounds. »
corrige: On demande un prix : l'argent est indénombrable → How much.
exercices.reponse: How much does this T-shirt cost?

exercices.enonce: Lis : « In my town, there are a lot of parks but there aren't any cinemas. There isn't much traffic. » Relève les trois quantifieurs et justifie chacun.
exercices.reponse: a lot of (affirmatif), any (négatif), much (négatif + indénombrable)

exercices.enonce: Écris deux phrases sur ta chambre : une avec « some » (books) et une avec « any » (posters).
exercices.reponse: Exemple de réponse : There are some books in my room. There aren't any posters.

exercices.enonce: Pose deux questions à un camarade : une sur le nombre de ses amis, une sur la quantité d'argent de poche (pocket money) qu'il reçoit.
corrige: friends dénombrable → How many ; pocket money indénombrable → How much.
exercices.reponse: How many friends do you have? How much pocket money do you get?
